12iSets filters: where Select and Group go
Phone and iPad portrait: Group and Select move out of "Other filters" into a View block at the end of the Filters sheet, under a divider, because they change how the list looks, not what it holds. Desktop: they stay in the toolbar's Options menu.

12jFirst run without keys (standalone)
A fresh install: empty collection, no keys, no catalogues (test-data/empty-states.json, firstRun). One path: keys, then catalogues, then Add. Later steps stay visible but disabled until the earlier one is done. An action that needs a missing key stays in place, disabled, names the key and links to Catalogues & keys (Manage 12l).
